description: Reopen r-sort-3b-memo (General) read-only. Reads (ID, LEN(MK), LEN(TK)) in ID order, and the ID sequences of ORDER BY MK, MK DESC, MK then ID, TK, TK then ID and TK DESC on MM. Asks the stored memo lengths and whether a memo sort key is refused, truncated (and at which length) or complete, against a Text(255) key that is truncated by construction, including the A x254 + B, A x255 + x and A x256 + x neighbors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
